recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-35830; any future wording changes to this introduction should be handled through a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-35830 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 FHIR-I clarification asking to fix punctuation in the FHIR Documents introduction, remove Implementation Guides from non-clinical examples, broaden future-profile guidance beyond only clinical documents, use the exact DocumentReference resource name, and clarify the scope of DocumentReference references.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 30c5d5f934984dbf392d563c3e48693061af5f1f, titled 'Updates for FHIR-33942, 17060, 8025, and 35830'. That commit edited source/documents.html to remove the FHIR Implementation Guides example, add the missing period, broaden the profile sentence to other non-clinical documents, change 'document reference resource' to 'DocumentReference resource', and say DocumentReference can reference documents including FHIR documents, PDFs, and CDAs.
additional_context: source/documents.html is part of the current build through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Later same-paragraph or nearby documents-page edits, especially FHIR-38933 and FHIR-39121, rephrased the introduction and DocumentReference sentence but preserved the FHIR-35830 substance. FHIR-I WGM minutes from May 2022 corroborate the Persuasive 22-0-0 vote, and community searches found no direct Zulip discussion or conflicting Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already omits Implementation Guides from the examples, addresses clinical and non-clinical document purposes, uses the DocumentReference resource name, and explains that DocumentReference may reference FHIR documents as well as PDFs, CDAs, and other documents.
